oneLine: Tata Motors acquired Iveco in a $4.5 billion deal.

sources.title: Tata Motors completes Iveco acquisition to turbocharge global play
Tata Motors' Iveco takeover bid clears 80 pc acceptance threshold

synopsis: Tata Motors Ltd has completed the acquisition of Italian truckmaker Iveco Group in a deal with an enterprise value of about $4.5 billion. The transaction follows a 15-month process and concluded after a tender offer closed with nearly 88% of Iveco shares tendered, allowing the deal to proceed toward full control and delisting. The combination brings together two commercial vehicle makers with annual sales exceeding 540,000 vehicles and revenues over $25 billion. Tata Motors raised its final offer to €14.40 a share from €14.10 following resistance from some minority shareholders and activist investor Petrus Advisers. Top executives including Natarajan Chandrasekaran, P.B. Balaji, and Girish Wagh are set to join Iveco’s board.
